games.name: Examination
games.desc:
!! This game is a heavy WIP and just a passion project, so expect bugs and non-final content. !!
"You are going nowhere but to hell... I hope you like it there."

Examination is a PvE horror shooter, where you're tasked to clear a highly irradiated nuclear power plant that's turned into a laboratory in the wake of the WE-30 outbreak, a nation-spanning infection that, while not indiscriminate, has swallowed select zones and regions whole, reducing them to heavily quarantined White-Zones. 
You're one of the later waves sent to the facility. What fate has befallen to the earlier waves is unknown. Don't become one of them.

Things to note:
7+ graphics are recommended.
Best played on a private server
The controls are laid out on the screen at the class lockers
The game is challenging and you are expected to falter in the beginning, don't give up!

Rules & Credits - https://devforum.roblox.com/t/examination-rules-credits/3809900
